firstDiaSourceMjdTaiFink.doc: MJD for the first detection by Rubin. Temporary replacement for diaObject.firstDiaSourceMjdTai which is not yet populated by the project

is_cataloged.doc: True if the last diaSource (alert) of the diaObject (object) has a counterpart in either SIMBAD or Gaia DR3. False otherwise.

is_first.doc: True if the alert is not a Solar System object and has no history (first detection at this location).

is_sso.doc: True if the diaSource is associate to a known Solar System object. False otherwise.

main_label_classifier.doc: Main prediction from Fink classifiers for the last received alert of this object. This is currently set to the CATS prediction only (f:clf_cats_class). Subject to change.

main_label_crossmatch.doc: Main association from various crossmatches for the last received alert of this object. This is currently set to the SIMBAD label only (f:xm_simbad_otype). Subject to change.

dec.doc: Declination coordinate of the position of the object [deg].

firstDiaSourceMjdTai.doc: Time of the first diaSource, expressed as Modified Julian Date, International Atomic Time.

g_psfFluxErrMean.doc: Mean of the g band flux errors [nJy].

g_psfFluxMean.doc: Weighted mean point-source model magnitude for g filter [nJy].

g_psfFluxNdata.doc: The number of g-band data points.

g_psfFluxSigma.doc: Standard deviation of the distribution of g_psfFlux [nJy].
